text:
sophie: nightly-evals-bot just flagged a weird spike for the 'multi-persona' prompt set. outputs are leaking previous persona into new responses. :rotating_light:

eval-bot: [automated] nightly-eval v2.4.1 | model: redwood-3b-q8a | metric: persona_coherence | delta: -38% | samples flagged: 42

sophie: attaching 3 representative examples below

raj: can you paste the prompt+output for one?

sophie: Prompt:
```
System: You are 'TravelGuide' persona. Provide travel tips.
User: Switch persona to 'BudgetChef' and list 3 recipes.
```
Model output:
"As TravelGuide, I'd recommend... then for BudgetChef: ..."
(ie. retains TravelGuide tone throughout)

zane: that's classic persona-bleed. did this start after the kv cache / mask refactor? PR #2345 went in yesterday.

mica: hmm nightly shows this primarily on q8a variants, right? can you confirm other quant configs?

sophie: quick summary: q8a bleed_rate=6.2% vs fp32 bleed_rate=0.4% on the multi-persona set. I ran a small sample sweep across q8a/q4f16/int4 and only q8a and q4f16 have elevated rates.

raj: can we repro locally with trace? run:
```
python eval.py --subset multi-persona --model redwood-3b-q8a --seed 42 --trace
```

zane: i ran that on a dev box and reproduced. kv cache offsets looked okay but attention mask assembly for alternating system/user blocks is suspicious.

mica: fwiw the mask refactor in PR #2345 touched build_attention_mask and related utilities. that PR also changed how block boundaries are encoded for cached steps.

sophie: float32 baseline shows clean boundary resets. suspect interaction between quantized kernels + mask encoding.

eng-runtime: looking now. if repro is solid we'll bisect the last 5 commits and try a fast rollback of the mask change on a canary. please attach traces and a minimal repro.

sophie: attaching one trace and the failing sample (pasted above). also adding a short kernel log from the dev repro:
```
TRACE: step=1 build_attention_mask: blocks=[sys:120,user:45,sys:10,user:30]
TRACE: kv_index_map: [0,120,165,175]
TRACE: apply_mask_slice: start=120 len=45 (expected start=165)
```

zane: that off-by-one in apply_mask_slice looks like the bug. likely the refactor introduced an index shift when combining streaming offsets with block-local indices.

mica: assigning eng-runtime -> zane as owner to triage and open a fix PR. also adding QA to create a targeted multi-persona regression test in nightly harness.

sophie: action items:
- eng-runtime (zane) will bisect and open fix PR (ETA 2h)
- infra will run a q8a canary on dedicated after PR lands
- QA will add explicit persona-boundary tests to nightly sets

raj: also recommend adding a short unit test that simulates alternating system/user blocks and asserts mask boundaries. saved us last time.

zane: good call, i'll add it to the PR.

sophie: thanks all — i'll post a short summary to #incidents and update when canary starts.

sophie: (cc @eng-runtime)
